title: Constructible geometric fibre dimensions in the source coherent-cohomology API
statement: Let S be Noetherian and f:X→S a smoothness-independent projective morphism presented as a closed immersion i:X→P(n;S) for a finite type n, followed by projection. Let G be a quasi-coherent finitely presented O_X-module flat over S [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. For each r in N let phi(s) be the dimension over the algebraic closure of kappa(s) of the source module cohomology H^r of the pullback of G to X times_S Spec(kappa(s)^alg). Then phi has finite range and every level set is constructible. This attaches the already proved source API used in the proof of lem-fin-projective-flat-coherent-ranks. It introduces no new cohomology convention or mathematical assumption.

proof.text: The source base-change formula for hFiber identifies the geometric fibre dimension with the residue-fibre dimension: apply hFiber_pullback_of_isPullback to the geometric point and evaluate at a point of its field spectrum. Extension of the residue field preserves dimension.

The proper flat coherent semicontinuity theorem gives upper semicontinuity of this natural-valued function. On the Noetherian space S, the increasing open sublevel sets cover S, so compactness bounds the function and its range is finite. The m-level set is the difference of the open sublevel sets for m+1 and m; all opens are retrocompact on a Noetherian space. Hence every level is constructible. This is the existing source proof, including UpperSemicontinuous.finite_range_and_isConstructible.
